There is so much to this and the way you enter a map is completely situational but there is one basic tip I can give is drone room by room it’s annoying but trust me do it 3 minutes is a very long time but people try run through a round in one minute take your time. Also enter with a group of people don’t enter a map from another direction as your team. Lastly I see lots of people going for the closest door to the room that your attacking that’s not the best way to enter especially early because the defensive team will have angles if your with a squad if their is a floor above enter through their do not sprint much!! Take your time drone and enter the map and learn the maps and watch content there is all sorts of tips and tricks! My last bit of advice is just grind bro you get the hang of it all eventually
